svg.title: Mouse Foxp3 and human FOXP3 alignment
svg.desc: Reflow of the supplied alignment into 80-column blocks, preserving all 432 alignment columns and original gaps. Vertical bars mark exact residue identities only. The forkhead domain, alignment columns 338 through 421, is shaded across two blocks. A star marks alignment column 277, mouse residue K276, at the scurfy site. Mouse length is 429 residues and human length 431. Other source boxes, underlines, and arrows are omitted.
